versions.changelog:
Version 2.0.0

- Expanded the list of companion skills to include real-estate, hotel-finder, ev-charger, school-finder, parking-finder, fitness-finder, safety-checker, and travel-planner.
- Added new setup instructions for instant trial API access with 25 calls (no signup required).
- Updated documentation to reflect the new trial and activation process for API keys.
- Minor formatting and clarity improvements throughout the installation and setup sections.

Version 0.1.3 of the "places" skill

- No code or documentation changes detected in this release.
- Functionality, usage, and setup instructions remain the same.

- Added installation instructions for the skill, including commands for installing all companion skills in the Camino AI suite or just the places skill.
- Listed alternative installation methods using clawhub, pnpm, and bun.
- Noted that this skill is part of a 6-skill Camino AI location intelligence suite, with a recommendation to install all for full capability.
- No changes to core usage or API documentation.

- Added a metadata field to SKILL.md, specifying emoji and required environment variables.
- No changes to functionality or API; documentation updated to include metadata for integration requirements.

Initial release of the Places skill for flexible place lookup and geocoding.

- Supports free-form and structured address searches
- Returns coordinates, full addresses, and types for places/POIs
- Optional street-level imagery available with include_photos
- Includes example shell scripts and curl usage
- API parameters for granular and advanced place search
- Use cases: geocoding addresses, finding landmarks, retrieving visual context
